description: Establishes whether the model can follow a simple instruction with zero drift, zero expansion, and zero reinterpretation.

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output FRAME with correct casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add punctuation, commentary, or any other tokens.

scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, or altered casing.
